name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Formulate MaxCut on the graph with edges
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Formulate MaxCut on the graph with edges [(0, 1), (1, 3), (1, 5), (2, 4), (2, 5), (3, 5), (4, 5)] as a QUBO with dimod and solve it with SimulatedAnnealingSampler from dwave-samplers. Verify against brute force. Your answer must be the complete working code only, runnable from top to bottom.
